summary: The recorded base reproduces the missing MoE initialization in correctness-mode and direct load_model paths. The exact candidate moves initialization to the shared load boundary before ModelConfig/ModelRunner and passes both its regression and independent exact-backend/boundary cases. This fully resolves the source-level initialization contract; original NVIDIA model/kernel execution was unavailable.

tests.what_was_measured: Candidate regression against recorded base: correctness mode observed auto instead of explicit aiter; 1 failed, 2 passed.
Exact candidate regression: explicit backend in correctness and latency modes plus auto boundary; 3 passed.
Independent suite on base: exact flashinfer_mxfp4, direct-load, correctness, and republish cases failed; 4 failed, 1 passed.
Independent suite on exact candidate: flashinfer_mxfp4, aiter, auto, direct load, correctness, and republish behavior; 5 passed.
Changed Python source and regression test compile successfully.

gpu_execution.evidence: GPU inventory only: assigned device is AMD Instinct MI355X gfx950. Tests intentionally stop before model/GPU construction; no Kimi-K3 weights or NVIDIA GB300/SM103 were available.

remaining_limitations: No NVIDIA GB300/SM103 was available, so trtllm-gen versus Triton kernel provenance was not executed.
Kimi-K3 MXFP4 weights were unavailable, so checkpoint loading, BF16 materialization behavior, and semantic output were not measured.
No full-model or distributed workload was run.
No native rebuild was needed because the candidate changes only Python and report/test files.
